title: Reconcile backlog merges and rebases through one Git adapter

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage for the named-branch rebase dispute

**Verdict.** Caught. The maintained direction-dispute case fails when the real CLI accepts a disputed result after Git has cleanly replayed the named branch.

**Story and revision.** `SEED-423#reconcile-the-backlog-through-one-git-adapter` in `.planning/seeds/SEED-423-shrink-the-installed-distribution.md`, slice 2 of `.planning/slice-plans/821-reconcile-the-backlog-through-one-git-adapter/PLAN.md`, checked at `f625c789b34efe77a53f820139934681e5056e99` with implementation at `16a73cb2d008c88b03c08cb23d49ff7254d11113`. The story promises to refuse a disputed whole-replay result and leave it recoverable when Git itself finishes cleanly.

**Fault and maintained check.** In the scratch copy of `Distribution/src/skills/dough-product-backlog/scripts/product-backlog-git-rebase-aggregate.mjs:60`, changed `if (refusal !== undefined)` to `if (false)` in `acceptCleanRebase`. The comparison still ran, and the fault bypassed its disputed receipt. Fixtures and assertions stayed unchanged. `Distribution/tests/support/product-backlog-git-rebase-clean.test.mjs:40` creates a named feature with two direction changes after the cutoff. The first matches the destination and the second diverges. It invokes `rebase --onto HEAD --ref <cutoff> --branch feature` and checks the exit at line 83. The caught assertion expected exit 1 and received exit 0 with the erroneous agreement receipt. The duplicate-move case in the same file also failed at its exit assertion, while the retired-option case passed.

**Independent observation.** Separate local Git fixtures started with parallel work, a destination that allows one task at a time, and a named feature that first matched the destination and then chose overnight-only work. The unmodified and restored real CLI returned exit 1, named the direction dispute, and pointed to read-only `validate`. With the fault, the CLI returned exit 0, reported agreement, and wrote no stderr. In each run the feature tip kept the overnight direction and had the destination as parent. Git left the original feature tip in `ORIG_HEAD`, the cutoff-only file absent, and no unmerged paths or active rebase state. This demonstrates the wrong acceptance in an otherwise clean named-branch replay.

**Runs and restoration.** The same focused Distribution selection passed all three cases at baseline, caught the fault with two failed cases and one passed, then passed all three after restoring the original bytes. The scratch worktree started clean and matched that state after restoration. Its checkout and temporary branch were then removed and confirmed absent. The execution checkout's product and test files matched the checked revision.


**Next proof action.** No new proof for the observed refusal path. The result confirms the plan’s earlier aggregate-refusal finding on the delivered named-branch path.

**Retained report and observations.** `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-423.TgrU8d6S/report.md`, with the case outcomes, failure output and independent witness logs in the same directory.

- **Test runtime.** 3.8 seconds total (measured sum of the runner’s rounded file times). Baseline 1.3 seconds, faulted 1.2 seconds and restored 1.3 seconds. The independent witness and scratch setup are outside these timings.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separately measured human effort was supplied for this probe.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. The host did not provide a separate measure of active agent effort for this probe.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 157307 ms (measured), from 1795574252797 to 1795574410104 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision `f625c789b34efe77a53f820139934681e5056e99`. Caught. The maintained named-branch case distinguishes the disputed result, so no follow-up is needed.
